summary: Rent the Runway filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 announcing the launch of its previously announced $15,000,000 rights offering. Holders of Class A common stock at the September 25, 2026 record date received one right per share, each right exercisable for approximately 0.1251 shares at a $3.55 subscription price. Due bill trading applies through the ex-dividend date. Rights expire October 14, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. New York City time unless extended; no fractional shares will be issued. The company filed a related prospectus. Watch subscription take-up, potential overhang from unexercised rights, and use of proceeds.
